تشمأززن (form IVq)
# تَشْمَأْزِزْنَ (tašmaʔzizna) /taʃ.maʔ.ziz.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِشْمَأَزَّ (išmaʔazza)
# تُشْمَأْزَزْنَ (tušmaʔzazna) /tuʃ.maʔ.zaz.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِشْمَأَزَّ (išmaʔazza)
